sloka: ततः सीताम् समानीय सर्व आभरण भुषिताम् ।समक्षम् अग्नेः संस्थाप्य राघव अभिमुखे तदा ॥१-७३-२५॥
transliteration: tataḥ sītām samānīya sarva ābharaṇa bhuṣitām ।samakṣam agneḥ saṁsthāpya rāghava abhimukhe tadā ॥1-73-25॥

translations.english: Thereafter king Janaka brought Sita adorned with various ornaments and placed her in the presence of Agni in front of Rama, the enhancer of the joy of Kausalya. And said:
